visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a handheld eye-level shot of a tricolor Corgi standing on light-colored floor tiles. A human hand, partially visible, holds out a small green leafy treat which the dog takes gently. In the background, green and blue plastic crates are stacked, suggesting an outdoor or semi-outdoor storage area with bright, natural daylight. (2) The camera moves to capture the second Corgi as the hand offers another treat. The first dog remains in the frame, watching the interaction. The setting is a transition space, possibly a storefront or a patio, characterized by a clean tiled surface and soft natural lighting coming from the side. (3) One of the Corgis drops its treat and begins licking and chewing it off the floor tiles. The person, wearing blue and white striped trousers, reaches down to affectionately pet the dog's head and neck. The dog's expressions are focused and content as it finishes its snack amidst some visible drool on the tile. (4) A final close-up focuses on the Corgi's snout as it thoroughly licks the last bits from the floor. The background shows the other dog wandering slightly. The overall scene is intimate and casual, emphasizing the bond between the owner and the pets in an everyday setting.

The pitch is high, and the delivery is melodic, typical of talking to pets. There is a noticeable background hum of urban traffic and outdoor ambient noise floor, providing a sense of a public or street-side environment. (2) The speaker gives a gentle command, 'bié tiào bié tiào' (don't jump), as a dog moves excitedly. The voice shows high pitch variability and moderate intensity. A subtle rustling sound of clothing and the faint 'tick' of dog claws on the hard tile floor are audible, layered over the continuous city ambience. (3) As the dog begins to eat, the male voice changes to a soft, praising tone, saying 'zhème hǎo chī a' (is it so delicious?). Distinct, high-frequency 'crunching' and 'wet licking' sound effects are produced by the dog, which are the most prominent transients in this phase. No background music is heard throughout. (4) The video concludes with the speaker laughing softly and repeating encouraging words. The acoustic environment remains consistent with high-frequency clarity in the vocal track. The sound of the person petting the dog's fur creates a soft, friction-based noise, while the distant urban rumble remains a stable low-frequency baseline in the mix.
